title: BCrypt 72-byte server password encoder ceiling rejection
fix: Preserved exactly. Must not be masked by an arbitrary 72-char frontend constraint. Reconcile at backend policy level.

title: Template catalog search lacking clear button
fix: Added search clear button with aria-label and reset handler; verified in unit & E2E tests.

title: Host template browse page lacking dark mode tokens
fix: Implemented dark mode styling with var(--ui-theme-*) tokens for summary cards, toolbar, chips, cards, buttons.
tests: Playwright spec test 05 across 6 viewport/theme combinations

title: Color contrast failure on pricing page label and Axe rule suppression test tamper
fix: Replaced #926c34 with var(--ui-theme-link, #76572d) yielding 6.19:1 contrast (WCAG AA requires 4.5:1). Removed disableRules(['color-contrast']) from Axe E2E test.
tests: Playwright spec test 07 across 6 projects with color-contrast rule enabled

title: Missing .tp-category-buttons container styling and search clear button sizing distortion
fix: Added .tp-category-buttons flex wrapper rules and enforced min-height: auto !important on .kp-search-clear-btn to prevent parent button rule override.

title: Unstyled dark mode public catalog typography and buttons
fix: Added explicit dark mode selectors for .tp-title, .tp-header-section p, .tp-category-buttons button, .tp-results-count, and filter labels.

title: Hardcoded 'Popular choice' marketing badge on STANDARD plan tier
fix: Replaced promotional claim with neutral descriptive language: 'Full-featured tier' / 'កញ្ចប់ពេញលេញ' per Section 10 specification.
